title: enderPearlsVanishOnDeath for 1.20.1
description: Backport of the enderPearlsVanishOnDeath gamerule for Fabric 1.20.1.
body:
# enderPearlsVanishOnDeath for 1.20.1

Backport of the [`enderPearlsVanishOnDeath` gamerule](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Game_rule#enderPearlsVanishOnDeath) for Fabric 1.20.1. (The gamerule was added in 1.20.2-pre1.)

## Alternatives

Fabric 1.17-1.20: [Persistent Pearls](https://modrinth.com/mod/persistent-pearls) adds a similar gamerule. However, their mixin may break other mods that modify vanilla pearl behavior.
